name: twitch auth
info: Provides a link to authorize the bot in your Twitch channel.
description:
### Authorization Guide
To grant **butterbror** permission to interact with your channel, follow these steps:

1. Click the authorization link generated by `_auth`.
2. Log in with your Twitch account.
3. Copy the token code and whisper it back to the bot.

> Note: Never share your OAuth tokens in public channels!

| Feature | Required Scope |
| --- | --- |
| Chat Read | `user:read:chat` |
| Chat Send | `user:write:chat` |
